## Working papers, 2026

Unrefereed and self-published. Each is a reproducible Quarto build — the figures
and numbers regenerate from the code in the repository.

**[Single-Parameter Gauge-Covariant Loop-Flow Control for Phase-Shifting Transformers and Meshed Converter Networks](phase-power.qmd)**
A single feedback parameter per mesh loop, driven by loop holonomy, closing the
gap between fast local converter control and day-ahead PST optimal power flow.
Simulation stage. [PDF](../assets/phase-power.pdf)

**[Phase Descent: Identifying Error Lineage in Passive Correlators from Harmonic Phase Coherence](phase-descent-calibration.qmd)**
Distortion from a single latent perturbation through a single nonlinearity
yields angular harmonics obeying $\phi_n - n\phi_1 = 0 \pmod{\pi}$, separating
analyzer from recombiner asymmetry in one angular sweep.
[PDF](../assets/phase-descent-calibration.pdf)

**[Bell Violations as Three-Party Quadratic Conservation: A Classical Three-Phase Realization](three-phase-bell-realization.qmd)**
The CHSH bound tracks the algebraic order of the source conservation law. A
structural construction requiring a non-local constraint — not a refutation of
Bell's theorem. [PDF](../assets/three-phase-bell-realization.pdf)
